跨平台的 Agent 交互 Shell，运行在 Windows、macOS、Li: A cross-platform agent shell that runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS and HarmonyOS. It is both the familiar launcher for your apps and a proactive, intent-driven agent: every app is a touchpoint, backed by one shared memory and an understanding that keeps evolving.
由 Makepad 的 Splash 演化而来、面向 Agent 需求优化的动态: A dynamic DSL evolved from Makepad's Splash and tuned for agents. It interprets app logic and generates UI in real time with no compile step: JavaScript-like on the surface, Rust underneath. App Cards and theme kits are built with it.
可嵌入的 Rust 原生 Agent harness 内核。多轮交互、上下文与记: An embeddable, Rust-native agent harness kernel. Multi-turn interaction, context and memory, model providers, concurrent agents, tools, sandboxing and user approval are all exposed to apps through the OS UI protocol.
OctoSense 是运行在操作系统之上的 Agent 交互 Shell。它看起: OctoSense is an agent shell on top of your operating system. It looks like the launcher and the apps you already know, and it behaves like an agent that understands your intent, senses what is changing around you, and reshapes those apps before you ask.
今天的 Agent 界面都是聊天框：线性、单向、只有文本。OctoSense 走: Today's agent interfaces are chat windows: linear, one-way, text only. OctoSense takes the other road. It keeps the app interactions people already know and puts the agent inside the apps, instead of pulling people into a chat box.
新闻、天气、行情、出行仍是稳定的起点，入口之下的内容围绕你的意图生成。: News, weather, markets and travel stay stable places to start. Beneath each one, the content is generated around your intent.
由时间和事件驱动：降温、航班延误、日程变化，都会让应用重新组织、提前准备。: Driven by time and events: a cold front, a delayed flight or a schedule change makes the apps reorganize and prepare ahead.
把为十亿人打造的超级应用裁剪到你需要的部分，持续生成、持续进化。: Super apps built for a billion people are trimmed to what you need, generated and evolved continuously.
重要决定留给你。Agent 把一天提炼成几件需要确认的事，确认后一切随之更新。: The important decisions stay with you. The agent distills the day into a few things to confirm, and everything updates once you do.
风格、配色、字体随人和时刻变化。像章鱼一样，它在感知，也在变色。: Style, color and typography adapt to the person and the moment. Like an octopus, it senses and changes color.
你看到的每个应用都是触点。触点背后是同一个 Agent、同一份记忆，以及对你所处: Every app you see is a touchpoint. Behind them all is one agent, one memory, and an understanding of your world that keeps evolving.
